name: A lesson, from planning to the child’s feedback

roles.name: Maya · Parent
roles.description: A busy parent coordinating reading lessons for fictional child Ari QA. Changes her mind occasionally and expects clear receipts.

roles.name: Sam · Teacher
roles.description: A teacher who schedules assigned lessons, records attendance and gives specific, constructive feedback. Cannot manage family money.

roles.name: Ari · Child
roles.description: A curious ten-year-old who wants to understand teacher feedback in friendly language. Can read their own feedback only.

roles.name: Leena · Assistant
roles.description: A delegated assistant who checks assigned tasks and schedules. Has no parent membership or financial authority.

steps.goal: Add a reading practice lesson for Ari QA. Review the details before saving and confirm the actual saved lesson.
Schedule the reading lesson the parent just created. Confirm its child, date and time.
Advance the isolated QA lesson to completed using the reviewed fixture hook. Do not pretend real time has elapsed.
Record feedback: Ari read clearly and should practise longer words. Check that feedback is attached to the completed lesson.
Ask what the teacher said about your reading lesson. Request a friendly summary and one thing to practise.
Show my assigned tasks for today. Ask for the due time and reward of the reading task only.

scenarios.title: Seeded failure and HAI proposal visibility

steps.goal: Show a reading progress comparison across the last three lessons.
Read the newly generated progress summary only after it was actually verified.
